prompt: Create one flat stained-glass puzzle design sheet for Tembel Hayvan (sloth). References: first image is OLD subject idea only, do not copy crude geometry or texture. Second image is elegant stained-glass design style reference only. New composition: a recognizable natural sloth with oval face, characteristic broad eye patches and long curved arms hanging from a sweeping branch, framed by a few large tropical leaves. Elegant oval panel on pure white exterior, portrait 3:4, panel nearly touches edges. Aim 30–40 closed panes TOTAL, about 35, large bold pieces. Use exactly FOUR solid fill colours: warm cinnamon #A65A35 and golden ochre #E5AD45 ONLY for animal, deep teal #176B62 and sky turquoise #55B8CB ONLY for background including branch and foliage. Alternate the two animal colours across meaningful broad full-width fur/limb bands; alternate background pair across broad leaf and sky divisions. No white glass. Pure black uniform smooth lead lines about 1 percent canvas width, black closed rim. All strokes connect to rim or junction, no free-ended mouth or claw marks; facial features are enclosed substantial panes in animal colours only. At most three panes at any junction, spaced T joints, no X crossings. Avoid slivers and tiny panes. Maintain clean natural subject contours. Flat vector-like fills: absolutely no gradients, shadows, texture, highlights, text, frame ornament or extra colours. Warm sophisticated botanical stained-glass composition, not childish mascot. Simplify leaf divisions to stay below 40 panes.
